purpose: Public research register for 36 sources considered during the design of the e2e readiness skill.
scope: Selected public documentation, skills, source files, manifests, and pages were inspected. No source was installed, executed, or vendored.
limitations: The observed date is an access date, not proof of the state of mutable content on an earlier date.
Public URLs are not byte pins; a separately mentioned tag or release does not identify every file reviewed.
No host compatibility, benchmark savings, vulnerability reproduction, certification, or product readiness result was produced.
License status applies only to the inspected scope; distributed files and transitive dependencies need separate review.

resources.integration_caveat: Structural validation does not prove semantic fit or safety; do not load an entire catalog for a narrow task.

resources.integration_caveat: Keep a whole-package dependency on hold when its router, state, or permissions compete with the canonical core.
